scientific_integrity: An elementary infinite descent proves the universal result; exhaustive finite checks are corroborative only. The motivating primary paper and its semiprime support criterion are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Only reciprocal divisibility for the sixth cyclotomic polynomial and squarefree inputs with at most two prime factors are classified.
Cycles of length at least three and prime-power support with exponents larger than one remain open within this analysis.
An earlier unindexed treatment of the reciprocal-divisibility system cannot be excluded.
title: No nontrivial reciprocal divisibility pairs for the sixth cyclotomic polynomial
